highlights.title: Assistants remember your conversations
highlights.description: Within a document, assistants build on earlier discussions, thoughts, and Q&A, so you do not have to repeat context. They look up the source text, outline, and Reading Memory on their own when needed.

highlights.title: Replies continue after you close the window
highlights.description: Discussion replies and Reader Q&A keep running in the background and finish after a restart. Assistants mentioned together reply in parallel and show steps such as reading the source text.

highlights.title: Jump from a citation to the source
highlights.description: Passages and discussions cited in replies become links. One click moves the reader to the source text or opens that discussion, so checking evidence takes less effort.

highlights.title: Highlights open their whole chapter
highlights.description: In EPUBs, a request from a highlight lets the assistant read the whole chapter. Questions without a selection stop at your reading progress, so later chapters are not spoiled.

highlights.title: Correct parameters for new models
highlights.description: Preset models now match current releases, and models such as Claude 5, Gemini 3.8, and GPT-6 receive the right thinking and temperature parameters. The assistant execution mode setting is removed.
